about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm a Full-Stack Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience building scalable web applications and digital platforms. Currently at Darkcam S.A, I architect end-to-end solutions that integrate AI-assisted development workflows with cloud-native infrastructure.
about.p2: My approach combines robust backend engineering with polished frontend experiences, leveraging tools like Claude AI and GitHub Copilot to accelerate development while maintaining high code quality. I specialize in transforming complex business requirements into intuitive, performant products.
about.p3: Based in Quito, Ecuador with a Master of Engineering Studies (Computers) from the University of Wollongong, I bring both academic rigor and hands-on pragmatism to every project.

items.description: Building document signing platforms, APIs, and mobile apps. Leading staging environments on GCP & Vercel for universe-id, darkcam-signature, darkcam-hono-api, and pdf-signer projects.
Delivered web platforms for clients in automotive, logistics, GPS tracking and tourism. WordPress and custom React/Next.js builds, REST APIs, PostgreSQL/MongoDB databases.
Taught frontend web development. Trained students in best practices, code structure and problem-solving.
